description: React hook 'useChatApi' that manages chat session state, including sessions, files, messages, and interactions with backend APIs for a chat application.

methods.name: useChatApi()
methods.description: React hook managing chat sessions, files, messages, upload progress, and communication with backend API.

methods.name: loadSessions
methods.description: Loads chat sessions from backend and sets the first as active if none is selected.

methods.name: loadFiles
methods.description: Loads files associated with a specified session.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new chat session, refreshes session list, and sets new session as active.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches active chat session and resets local messages.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file from the session.

methods.name: uploadFiles
methods.description: Uploads one or multiple files, tracks progress and errors, and refreshes file list.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a user message, appends it locally, and retrieves assistant response from backend.
